notes: EBIT is defined as GAAP 'Income from operations' from the consolidated statements of income. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

D&A uses 'Depreciation and amortization' from the consolidated statements of cash flows. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

Capex is modeled as purchases of property and equipment plus acquisitions of intangible assets (to align with D&A that includes software amortization). Acquisitions of intangible assets are shown as '—' for FY2023 in the filing; treated as $0. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

NWC is computed as total current assets minus total current liabilities (company-reported working capital). This includes cash within current assets, which may differ from NWC definitions that exclude cash. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

FY2026 base-case growth and margin are anchored to management’s initial FY2026 guidance (reported revenue growth midpoint and operating margin midpoint). Post-2026 drivers are conservative model assumptions due to no explicit public multi-year guidance. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

Tax rate uses FY2026 effective tax guidance (~21.3%) rather than FY2025 historical effective tax rate. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

WACC is an assumption (8.0%) and is not explicitly disclosed in company filings/earnings materials; modeled for a recurring, mid-risk healthcare platform. Terminal growth (2.5%) is also an assumption.

NOL balance is disclosed as approximately $22.5 million available to offset future taxable income; NOL utilization percent is not disclosed and is therefore assumed (0.50). ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))
Current price is a market-data snapshot from the pricing tool: $577.26 (as of 2026-03-21 UTC).

Comps: EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA are sourced from Stockanalysis.com 'Enterprise Valuation' metrics and treated as proxies for EV/NTM multiples; EV/NTM Revenue/EBITDA are not explicitly labeled NTM in the cited source. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/zts/statistics/))

catalysts: Sustained expansion in the premium instrument installed base and continued traction in inVue Dx placements (execution-driven recurring revenue tailwind). ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

Ongoing adoption of newly launched companion animal diagnostic offerings (e.g., Cancer Dx) supporting incremental utilization and recurring consumables/service demand. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

Realization of targeted operating margin improvement (32.0% to 32.5% for FY2026) and continued operating leverage from commercial execution. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))
company_overview: IDEXX is a leader in companion animal diagnostics and water testing, reporting in major categories/segments including Companion Animal Group, Water, and LPD. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

A large portion of consolidated revenue is recurring diagnostic revenue (approximately 79% of consolidated revenue in FY2025), supported by installed-base dynamics and repeat testing. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

The company emphasizes improving test utilization in its customer base (i.e., more tests per patient sample and/or more samples processed). ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))
current_context: In the Feb 2026 earnings release, IDEXX provided initial FY2026 guidance: revenue of $4,632 million to $4,720 million (reported growth 7.6% to 9.6%), and targeted operating margin of 32.0% to 32.5%. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

The company also indicated an FY2026 effective tax rate of approximately 21.3% and FY2026 capital expenditures of approximately $180 million. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

For FY2025, IDEXX reported total revenue of $4,304 million (up 10% reported) and operating margin expansion, supporting the base-case view that profitability remains a key driver. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is anchored to management’s FY2026 guidance range and a gradual deceleration thereafter (no explicit public guidance beyond 2026, so post-2026 growth is modeled with conservative fade). ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

EBIT margin is modeled to remain in the low-to-mid 30% range, consistent with FY2026 operating margin guidance and historical operating leverage (FY2025 operating margin ~31.6%). ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

Cash conversion and reinvestment discipline are reflected in steady D&A and capex intensity assumptions (D&A/capex expressed as % of sales). ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

Working-capital intensity is assumed to normalize slightly upward from the FY2025 low level rather than returning abruptly to the FY2023 level, reflecting less volatility in a mature recurring base. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Downside utilization risk: macro and/or veterinary visit declines could reduce test volumes, particularly for recurring diagnostics. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

FX and macro/geo risks can impact reported revenue and operating income; guidance explicitly notes sensitivity to foreign currency impacts. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

Margin compression risk if operating expenses rise faster than revenue or if pricing/market dynamics weaken vs expectations. ([cdn.prod.nntech.io](https://cdn.prod.nntech.io/company-events/reports/97ce79d4-e318-3b67-bb8c-a669268a4702/report.pdf))

Tax and NOL realization uncertainty: the company discloses NOLs, but utilization assumptions are inherently modeling-based. ([ir.idexx.com](https://ir.idexx.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0000874716-26-000038/idxx-20251231.htm))

WACC is set at 8.0% as a conservative mid-cycle discount rate for a high-quality, recurring-revenue platform. (Assumption; not explicitly disclosed.)
